description: Unit test class for CalendarEventConflictResolver, containing tests for conflict resolution strategies and edge cases in calendar event synchronization.

classes.name: CalendarEventConflictResolverTest
classes.description: Test class extending SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase, implementing various unit tests for calendar event conflict resolution logic.

methods.name: testUnrelatedEventsSkipValidationInProductionMode
methods.description: Tests that unrelated events do not throw errors in production mode, validating relationship validation skips for performance.

methods.name: testYear2038TimestampWarning
methods.description: Validates that timestamps beyond 2038 trigger warnings to prevent overflow issues.

methods.name: testXSSPatternDetection
methods.description: Checks that scripts or suspicious patterns in event titles trigger security warnings.

methods.name: testSubSecondPrecisionDetection
methods.description: Verifies detection of modifications within the same second using microsecond precision, exceeding clock skew tolerance.

methods.name: testClockSkewTolerance
methods.description: Ensures small time differences due to clock skew do not falsely indicate modifications.

methods.name: testTimestampTieBreaker
methods.description: Ensures deterministic outcome when timestamps are identical, using event ID as a tie-breaker.

methods.name: testContentComparisonUsesChecksum
methods.description: Validates checksum-based content comparison for performance.

methods.name: testDeprecatedResolveConflictMethod
methods.description: Ensures backward compatibility with deprecated conflict resolution methods.

methods.name: testNeitherEventModified
methods.description: Scenario where neither event has been modified since last sync; expects no change.

methods.name: testOnlyTargetEventModified
methods.description: Scenario where only the target event was modified; expects target event as winner.

methods.name: testOnlySourceEventModified
methods.description: Scenario where only the source event was modified; expects source event as winner.

methods.name: testBothModifiedToIdenticalContent
methods.description: Scenario where both events modified but content converged; expects target event as winner.

methods.name: testTwoSidedConflictTimestampStrategy
methods.description: Both events modified; timestamp strategy selects the most recent.

methods.name: testTwoSidedConflictExternalBasedStrategyExternalWins
methods.description: Both events modified; external wins with EXTERNAL_BASED strategy.

methods.name: testTwoSidedConflictExternalBasedStrategyFallback
methods.description: Both events modified with same external status; fallback to timestamp.

methods.name: testTwoSidedConflictInternalBasedStrategyInternalWins
methods.description: Both events modified; internal wins with INTERNAL_BASED strategy.

methods.name: testTwoSidedConflictInternalBasedStrategyFallback
methods.description: Both events internal; fallback to timestamp for decision.

methods.name: testFirstSyncWithNullLastSync
methods.description: Initial sync where last_sync is null; triggers conflict resolution.
